description: Source code for HIP9011/TPIC8101 driver, including hardware interface, SPI communication, and engine integration logic.

classes.name: Hip9011Hardware
classes.description: Hardware interface implementation for HIP9011 driver, providing SPI command methods.

methods.name: sendSyncCommand
methods.description: Sends a synchronous SPI command to the hardware.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous SPI command to the hardware.

methods.name: showHipInfo
methods.description: Displays current HIP9011 driver status and configuration information.

methods.name: setHip9011FrankensoPinout
methods.description: Configures pinout and initial settings for HIP9011 on the hardware.

methods.name: startIntegration
methods.description: Begins HIP integration process, setting state and controlling pin.

methods.name: endIntegration
methods.description: Ends HIP integration process, resetting state and controlling pin.

methods.name: intHoldCallback
methods.description: Callback for shaft position to start or finish HIP integration based on trigger events.

methods.name: setMaxKnockSubDeg
methods.description: Sets maximum knock sub-degrees and updates display.

methods.name: setKnockThresh
methods.description: Sets knock voltage threshold and updates display.

methods.name: setPrescalerAndSDO
methods.description: Sets prescaler and SDO value for HIP9011.

methods.name: setHipBand
methods.description: Sets HIP band value and updates display.

methods.name: setHipGain
methods.description: Sets HIP gain value and updates display.

methods.name: endOfSpiExchange
methods.description: Callback after SPI exchange completes, resets state.

methods.name: hipAdcCallback
methods.description: Handles ADC input for knock voltage measurement.

methods.name: hipStartupCode
methods.description: Initializes HIP9011 hardware, configures SPI and device settings.

methods.name: hipThread
methods.description: Thread function for HIP9011 initialization loop.

methods.name: initHip9011
methods.description: Initializes HIP9011 driver, sets up pins, SPI, and commands.
